title: Header Case Configuration
description: Controls the casing of HTTP/1 header names that Envoy writes on the wire. Overrides win over the mode.

mode.description: preserve keeps the casing the peer sent; proper_case uppercases the first letter of each word (X-Foo-Bar); lowercase is Envoy's default.

fallback.description: Casing for header names the peer never sent, such as headers added by Envoy. Only valid when mode is preserve.

overrides.description: Exact spellings by header name, e.g. `{"content-type": "Content-type"}`. Names are matched case-insensitively and a spelling may only change the casing.
